title: PlasmaZones Animation Shader Metadata
description: metadata.json for a bundled or user animation-shader pack. Core identity and the parameter contract are enforced. Optional rendering keys (vertexShader, fboExtent, textures, appliesTo, geometryGrid), named parameter presets and descriptive metadata (description, author, version, category) are allowed through.

presets.description: Named parameter presets. Each value is a map of parameter id to value, naming a subset of the pack's declared parameters. A preset id is its key here and reaches the filesystem as <family>/<id>.json, so it must be a single safe path component. That rule is enforced by plasmazones-shader-validate rather than here, because the vendored JSON-schema validator rejects every name under a propertyNames rule, legitimate ones included.

type.description: Marshalling type of the uniform. An unknown type cannot be bound, so it is rejected.

default.description: Default value. Use a string for color (#rrggbb), a number for float or int, and a boolean for bool.
